g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS card payments processing across three availability zones

g.title: None.None.Node.39
g.text: The merchant posts the payment over mutual TLS; AWS WAF filters it
API Gateway passes it over a VPC link to the Network Load Balancer
which sends it to an authorisation task in one of three zones
The task records the idempotency key in DynamoDB, so a retried request is not charged twice
translates the PIN block with keys held in CloudHSM
asks the card network for authorisation over PrivateLink
and writes the result to the ledger on the Aurora writer
The task queues the approved payment on an SQS FIFO queue, grouped by merchant
Settlement tasks take each merchant's payments in order; failures move to the dead-letter queue
and post them to the ledger
